title: dev.qory.run.built
description: The result of a build of an image of an environment, as the run's caller writes it: the image by its digest, its size, the commit it was built from and the environment it is for. At most one per run, after dev.qory.run.started and before dev.qory.run.exited, outside every session and every step. The caller writes it with (*session.Run).Built, and Forager checks the form of each member and nothing else.

image.description: The image the run built, by its digest: NAME@sha256: and 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits, with no tag, of the form of a policy's image reference.

size.description: The image's size in bytes, 1 or more.

commit.description: The full commit id the image was built from: 40 or 64 hexadecimal characters, in lower case.

environment_ref.description: A reference to the environment the image is for, as the caller passes it: a string of 1 character or more, which Forager writes with no other check of its form.
